app.name: AI Tribe
login.title: Motor Claim Damage Detection AI Model
login.subtitle: Use your email or username and password to access this instance.
login.error_inactive: This account has been deactivated. Contact an administrator.
help.lead: Submit up to 10 photos and an optional short video of vehicle damage. Watch the assessment pipeline run, then review a parts-priced survey estimate.
help.vehicle_forensics_desc: Authenticity and reuse checks on submitted media before pricing starts.
help.deepfake_desc: Screens submitted photos for AI-generation and deepfake artefacts before pricing starts.
help.vmmr_desc: Make/model recognition with confidence tiers — low-confidence guesses need surveyor confirmation.
help.consistency_desc: Compares images within a claim so mixed-vehicle submissions surface as risk signals.
help.fraud_graph_desc: Network of claimants, surveyors, and garages linked by shared claims — flags high-degree nodes and recurring garage–surveyor pairs.
help.parts_estimate_desc: Maps damage to catalogue parts and prices; public-source prices are indicative only.

estimate.title: Survey estimate
estimate.extensive_damage_body: The assessment detected a possible extensive or total-loss pattern across multiple images. No auto-generated settlement total is shown. A surveyor must confirm damage scope and vehicle identity before pricing.
estimate.low_confidence_tier: Low-confidence tier — confirm before final pricing
estimate.approximate_body: No exact catalogue rows for this model. Unit prices use a same-make substitute ({substitute}). Treat totals as indicative until confirmed.
estimate.needs_confirmation_body: VMMR identified this vehicle as {make} {model}, but that class is in a low-confidence tier. Confirm make/model before relying on this estimate.
estimate.provisional_body: Make/model were not confirmed with sufficient confidence. Pricing uses the nearest catalogue match ({label}).

settings.title: Settings

settings.encryption_missing: Server encryption is not configured (LLM_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Key storage is disabled until an administrator sets this on the server.
settings.api_key_replace: Enter new key to replace saved key
marketplace.title: AI Tribe API Marketplace
marketplace.intro: Self-service partner API into the same claim assessment pipeline used by Enterprise and Chat. Generate a bearer token, subscribe to endpoints, then build an API chain from your subscriptions.
marketplace.token_format: Format {code}. Only the latest token is valid. Showing the token is logged for security review.
marketplace.no_token: No token yet — generate one to call the external API.
marketplace.catalog_intro: Subscribe to the APIs your integration needs. {submit_claim} is always on and cannot be disabled.
marketplace.tooltip_wip_locked: Coming soon — not yet available for subscription.
marketplace.salesforce_intro: Enter your Salesforce endpoints, then call {endpoint} to fetch stub lead details (WIP).
marketplace.chains_intro: Build a call sequence for integrators. {submit_claim} is always step 1. Each next step is chosen from APIs you have subscribed to; pick {end} when the chain is complete.
marketplace.chain_hint: Subscribe to at least one API above (besides Submit Claim) to add more steps — or leave step 2 as END for a submit-only chain.
marketplace.api.submit_claim.title: Submit Claim
marketplace.api.submit_claim.description: Start a new motor claim with surveyor, claimant, garage, and accident date. Returns a claim number and a short-lived upload token so photos can be attached next. Always enabled for every marketplace user.
marketplace.api.submit_images.title: Submit Images
marketplace.api.submit_images.descriptio: Attach damage photos or a short video to an existing claim. Use the upload token from Submit Claim, or your API token if you own the claim.
marketplace.api.claim_detail.title: Claim Detail
marketplace.api.claim_detail.description: Look up a claim by number (fuzzy match supported) and get status, intake fields, image count, and the latest pipeline stage.
marketplace.api.assessment_detail.title: Assessment Detail
marketplace.api.assessment_detail.descri: Read the multi-stage assessment pipeline: deepfake screening, vehicle identity, damage mapping, fraud checks, and whether work is still in progress.
marketplace.api.estimation_detail.title: Estimation Detail
marketplace.api.estimation_detail.descri: Fetch the survey estimate once pricing is ready: part line items, labour, totals, and pricing-basis notices (including approximate / fallback catalogue pricing).
marketplace.api.policy_details.title: Get Policy Details
marketplace.api.policy_details.descripti: Fetch policy information from the Policy Administration system for a claim (cover, policy number, status, and related policy attributes). Coming soon — not available for subscription yet.
marketplace.api.connect_salesforce.title: Connect Salesforce
marketplace.api.connect_salesforce.descr: Connect to your Salesforce org and fetch lead details into AI Tribe. Configure your Salesforce server and connector URLs after subscribing. Work in progress — returns stub lead data only.
